It is completely understandable that you are feeling hurt and unsure of how to cope right now. Long-distance relationships already require an immense amount of trust, and hearing that your partner has feelings for someone else can be incredibly unsettling, even if she describes it as "just a crush." 

Take some time to process your own emotions before deciding on your next steps. When you feel ready, it can be helpful to have an open, honest conversation with her about what this means for your relationship. You might ask her how she plans to handle these feelings and share how her admission has impacted your sense of security. It is important to establish boundaries that make you feel safe and respected. Remember to prioritize your own well-being right now, and consider leaning on trusted friends or family for support as you navigate this difficult situation.
